steps.say: Compare lengths by lining up the ends.

figure.title: Ribbons
figure.alt: The red ribbon is 8 cubes long. The blue ribbon is 5 cubes long.

steps.say: On a balance, the heavier side goes down.

figure.alt: A balance with a book on the left and a feather on the right. The left side is lower.

steps.say: A full jug has water to the top. An empty jug has none.

figure.alt: A jug filled with water right to the top.

steps.say: A ruler measures length in centimetres. Start at 0.

figure.alt: A pencil next to a ruler. It starts at 0 and ends at 9 cm.
A balance with an apple on the left and a melon on the right. The right side is lower.

hints: Look at which side goes down.
check.explanation: The melon side is lower, so the melon is heavier.

options.why: The apple side is higher, so the apple is lighter.

figure.alt: A crayon next to a ruler. It starts at 0 and ends at 6 cm.

hints: Check that the crayon starts at 0.
Look where the end of the crayon is.
Follow the end of the crayon down to the ruler.
check.explanation: The crayon starts at 0 and ends at 6, so it is 6 cm long.
